```{r Read and Save Epigenetics and Covariate Data}
Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates <- list()

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(
    substr(species_name, 1, 1),
    "_",
    substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name))
  )

  species_files <- list.files(
    path = R_Data,
    pattern = paste0("^", species_prefix, ".*bedgraph$"),
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  file_list <- lapply(species_files, function(f) {
    tryCatch(
      read.table(f, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", skip = 1),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })

  names(file_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(species_files))
  Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates[[species_name]] <- file_list
}
```

```{r Rename columns and Remove chr from Chromosome Names}
Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates <- lapply(Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates, function(file_list) {
  lapply(file_list, function(df) {
    if (!is.data.frame(df)) return(NULL)

    if (ncol(df) == 4) colnames(df) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "value")
    if (ncol(df) == 3) df <- df[, c("V1", "V2", "V2", "V3")]
    colnames(df) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "value")

    df$chrom <- sub("^chr", "", df$chrom)
    df$chrom <- sub("^Chr", "", df$chrom)

    df
  })
})
```

```{r New Method to Calculate Mean Levels and Associations}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests <- list()
Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests  <- list()

Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities <- list()
Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities <- list()
Species_XR_TCR_Gene_Densities <- list()

pc <- 1e-6

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  vcf_df <- subset(
    Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]],
    gene_biotype == "protein_coding"
  )

  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(
    substr(species_name, 1, 1),
    "_",
    substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name))
  )

  epigenetic_list <- Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates[[species_name]]
  if (is.null(epigenetic_list)) next

  gene_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = vcf_df$CHROM,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = vcf_df$start, end = vcf_df$end),
  strand   = vcf_df$strand,
  gene_id  = vcf_df$GENE_ID,
  gene_name = vcf_df$gene_name,
  dNdS_Group = vcf_df$Overall_dNdS_Group,
  expr_Group = vcf_df$Overall_Expression_Group,
  mut_Group  = vcf_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group
) %>% unique()

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Regular mark loop: windowed gene-body profiles + one value per gene
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  for (mark_name in names(epigenetic_list)) {

    mark_df <- epigenetic_list[[mark_name]]
    if (is.null(mark_df)) next

    mark_name_nospecies <- sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_", "", mark_name)

    mark_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = mark_df$chrom,
      ranges   = IRanges(start = mark_df$start, end = mark_df$end),
      value    = mark_df$value
    )

    body_epi_enrichment <- normalizeToMatrix(
      mark_gr,
      gene_gr,
      value_column = "value",
      extend = 1000,
      mean_mode = "weighted",
      w = 50,
      target_ratio = .7,
      smooth = FALSE,
      background = 0
    )

    mat <- as.matrix(body_epi_enrichment)

    # Gene-level scalar for downstream boxplots/correlations
    gene_mean <- rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    gene_mean[is.nan(gene_mean)] <- NA

    mean_mark_name <- paste("mean", mark_name_nospecies, sep = "_")

    gene_mean_df <- data.frame(
      GENE_ID = gene_gr$gene_id,
      mean_value = gene_mean,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    colnames(gene_mean_df)[2] <- mean_mark_name

    vcf_df <- dplyr::left_join(vcf_df, gene_mean_df, by = "GENE_ID")
    plot_vcf_df <- vcf_df %>% distinct(GENE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gene-body profile split by expression group
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    expr_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$expr_Group)

    expr_df <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(expr_group = expr_groups) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -c(expr_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(mat))))

    ExprDensities <- expr_df %>%
      group_by(expr_group, position) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    if (is.null(Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]])) {
      Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]] <- list()
    }
    Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]][[paste0(mark_name, "_ExprGroup")]] <- ExprDensities

    avg <- colMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    regionLength <- 0.7 * length(avg)
    lengthEachSide <- (length(avg) - regionLength) / 2
    start <- lengthEachSide
    end <- length(avg) - lengthEachSide

    ExprDensityPlot <-
      ggplot(
        ExprDensities %>% filter(!is.na(expr_group)),
        aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = expr_group, fill = expr_group)
      ) +
      geom_line(size = .5) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
                  alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(start, end), linetype = "dotted") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Enrichment of", mark_name_nospecies, "Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
        subtitle = "Grouped by expression group",
        x = "Windows",
        y = paste("Mean", mark_name_nospecies),
        color = "Expression Group",
        fill = "Expression Group"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3)
      ) +
      guides(
        fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
        colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
      )

    ggsave(
      plot = ExprDensityPlot,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_EnrichedHeatmaps/",
        species_prefix,
        "/GeneBody_Enrichment_of_", mark_name_nospecies, "_ExprGroup_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      bg = "transparent",
      type = "cairo",
      units = "cm",
      height = 6,
      width = 8,
      create.dir = TRUE,
      dpi = 2000
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gene-body profile split by mutation-rate group
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    mut_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$mut_Group)

    mut_df <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(mut_group = mut_groups) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -c(mut_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(mat))))

    MutationDensities <- mut_df %>%
      group_by(mut_group, position) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    if (grepl("(_plus$|_minus$)", mark_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]][[paste0(mark_name, "_MutGroup")]] <- MutationDensities
    }

    MutationDensityPlot <-
      ggplot(
        MutationDensities,
        aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = mut_group, fill = mut_group)
      ) +
      geom_line(size = .5) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
                  alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(start, end), linetype = "dotted") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Enrichment of", mark_name_nospecies, "Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
        subtitle = "Grouped by mutation rate group",
        x = "Windows",
        y = paste("Mean", mark_name_nospecies),
        color = "Mutation Rate Quantile",
        fill = "Mutation Rate Quantile"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2)
      ) +
      guides(
        fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
        colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
      )

    ggsave(
      plot = MutationDensityPlot,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_EnrichedHeatmaps/",
        species_prefix,
        "/GeneBody_Enrichment_of_", mark_name_nospecies, "_MutGroup_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      bg = "transparent",
      type = "cairo",
      units = "cm",
      height = 6,
      width = 8,
      create.dir = TRUE,
      dpi = 2000
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Downstream gene-level correlations and boxplots for this mark
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    plot_vcf_df <- plot_vcf_df %>%
      mutate(
        Overall_Mark_Group = cut_number(
          .data[[mean_mark_name]] + runif(n(), -1e-6, 1e-6),
          n = 5,
          labels = as.character(1:5),
          ordered_result = TRUE
        )
      )

    spearman_test <-
      cor.test(
        plot_vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
        plot_vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]],
        method = "spearman"
      )

    pearson_test <-
      cor.test(
        plot_vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
        plot_vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]],
        method = "pearson"
      )

    if (is.null(Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]])) {
      Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]] <- list()
      Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]]  <- list()
    }

    Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]] <- spearman_test
    Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]  <- pearson_test

    p1 <-
      ggplot(
        data = subset(plot_vcf_df, !is.na(plot_vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]])),
        aes(
          x = !!sym(mean_mark_name),
          y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
        )
      ) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          mean_mark_name, "\n",
          plot_vcf_df$GENE_ID %>% unique() %>% length(),
          "Unique Protein Coding Genes with Mark Estimate"
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Spearman Correlation: ",
          "p Value = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$p.value %>%
            signif(., digits = 5),
          ", ",
          "Coefficient = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$estimate %>%
            signif(., digits = 5),
          "\n",
          "Pearson Correlation: ",
          "p Value = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$p.value %>%
            signif(., digits = 5),
          ", ",
          "Coefficient = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$estimate %>%
            signif(., digits = 5)
        ),
        caption = "Line of best fit represents linear regression line produced using: geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE)"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
      )

    ggsave(
      plot = p1,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_MutationRate_Scatter_Plots/",
        species_prefix, "/",
        species_prefix, "_",
        mark_name_nospecies, "_versus_MutationRate", "_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 5,
      height = 4,
      dpi = 300
    )

    plot_df <- plot_vcf_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[mean_mark_name]])) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[["UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"]]))

    p2 <-
      ggplot(
        plot_df,
        aes(
          x = Overall_Mark_Group,
          y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
          fill = Overall_Mark_Group
        )
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          species_prefix, "\n",
          plot_df %>%
            filter(!is.na(Overall_Mark_Group), !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)) %>%
            pull(GENE_ID) %>%
            unique() %>%
            length(),
          " Protein Coding Genes\nwith Embryonic ", mark_name
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Jonckheere = ",
          jonckheere.test(
            plot_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
            plot_df$Overall_Mark_Group,
            alternative = "two.sided"
          )$statistic %>% round(3),
          ", p = ",
          jonckheere.test(
            plot_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
            plot_df$Overall_Mark_Group,
            alternative = "two.sided"
          )$p.value %>% round(3)
        )
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = colorRampPalette(
          c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
        )(length(unique(plot_df$Overall_Mark_Group)))
      ) +
      guides(fill = "none") +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
      )

    ggsave(
      plot = p2,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_MutationRate_JK_Plots/",
        species_prefix, "/",
        species_prefix, "_",
        mark_name_nospecies, "_Bins_versus_MutationRate", "_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      bg = "transparent",
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 2,
      height = 3,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # XR TCR: use plus/minus tracks, orient by gene strand
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  xrplus_names <- names(epigenetic_list)[grepl("_plus$", names(epigenetic_list), ignore.case = TRUE)]

  if (length(xrplus_names) > 0) {

    for (plus_name in xrplus_names) {

      minus_name <- sub("_plus$", "_minus", plus_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
      if (!minus_name %in% names(epigenetic_list)) next

      plus_df  <- epigenetic_list[[plus_name]]
      minus_df <- epigenetic_list[[minus_name]]

      if (is.null(plus_df) || is.null(minus_df)) next

      tcr_id <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", plus_name)

      plus_gr <- GRanges(
        seqnames = plus_df$chrom,
        ranges   = IRanges(start = plus_df$start, end = plus_df$end),
        value    = plus_df$value
      )
      strand(plus_gr) <- "+"

      minus_gr <- GRanges(
        seqnames = minus_df$chrom,
        ranges   = IRanges(start = minus_df$start, end = minus_df$end),
        value    = minus_df$value
      )
      strand(minus_gr) <- "-"

      plus_mat <- as.matrix(normalizeToMatrix(
        plus_gr,
        gene_gr,
        value_column = "value",
        extend = 1000,
        mean_mode = "weighted",
        w = 50,
        target_ratio = .7,
        smooth = FALSE,
        background = 0
      ))

      minus_mat <- as.matrix(normalizeToMatrix(
        minus_gr,
        gene_gr,
        value_column = "value",
        extend = 1000,
        mean_mode = "weighted",
        w = 50,
        target_ratio = .7,
        smooth = FALSE,
        background = 0
      ))

      gene_strand <- as.character(strand(gene_gr))

      template_mat <- plus_mat
      nontemplate_mat <- minus_mat

      template_mat[gene_strand == "+", ] <- minus_mat[gene_strand == "+", , drop = FALSE]
      nontemplate_mat[gene_strand == "+", ] <- plus_mat[gene_strand == "+", , drop = FALSE]

      template_mat[gene_strand == "-", ] <- plus_mat[gene_strand == "-", , drop = FALSE]
      nontemplate_mat[gene_strand == "-", ] <- minus_mat[gene_strand == "-", , drop = FALSE]

      tcr_mat <- log2((template_mat + pc) / (nontemplate_mat + pc))

      mean_TCR <- rowMeans(tcr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
      mean_TCR[is.nan(mean_TCR)] <- NA

      tcr_gene_df <- data.frame(
        GENE_ID = gene_gr$gene_id,
        template_mean = rowMeans(template_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
        nontemplate_mean = rowMeans(nontemplate_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_TCR = mean_TCR,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      if (is.null(Species_XR_TCR_Gene_Densities[[species_name]])) {
        Species_XR_TCR_Gene_Densities[[species_name]] <- list()
      }
      Species_XR_TCR_Gene_Densities[[species_name]][[tcr_id]] <- tcr_gene_df

      tcr_gene_col <- paste0("mean_TCR_", tcr_id)

      tcr_gene_df2 <- tcr_gene_df[, c("GENE_ID", "mean_TCR")]
      colnames(tcr_gene_df2)[2] <- tcr_gene_col
      plot_vcf_df <- dplyr::left_join(plot_vcf_df, tcr_gene_df2, by = "GENE_ID")

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------
      # TCR gene-body profile split by expression group
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------
      expr_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$expr_Group)

      tcr_expr_df <- as.data.frame(tcr_mat) %>%
        mutate(expr_group = expr_groups) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = -c(expr_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
        mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(tcr_mat))))

      TCR_ExprDensities <- tcr_expr_df %>%
        group_by(expr_group, position) %>%
        summarise(
          mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      if (is.null(Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]])) {
        Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]] <- list()
      }
      Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]][[paste0(tcr_id, "_ExprGroup")]] <- TCR_ExprDensities

      avg <- colMeans(tcr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
      regionLength <- 0.7 * length(avg)
      lengthEachSide <- (length(avg) - regionLength) / 2
      start_tcr <- lengthEachSide
      end_tcr <- length(avg) - lengthEachSide

      TCR_ExprGroupPlot <-
        ggplot(
          TCR_ExprDensities %>% filter(!is.na(expr_group)),
          aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = expr_group, fill = expr_group)
        ) +
        geom_line(size = .5) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
                    alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(start_tcr, end_tcr), linetype = "dotted") +
        labs(
          title = paste("TCR Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
          subtitle = "Grouped by expression group",
          x = "Windows",
          y = "Mean log2(template / non-template)",
          color = "Expression Group",
          fill = "Expression Group"
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        theme(
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3)
        ) +
        guides(
          fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
          colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = TCR_ExprGroupPlot,
        filename = paste0(
          R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
          "Epigenetic_TCR_Plots/",
          species_prefix,
          "/TCR_", tcr_id, "_ExprGroup_", element_name, ".png"
        ),
        bg = "transparent",
        type = "cairo",
        units = "cm",
        height = 6,
        width = 8,
        create.dir = TRUE,
        dpi = 2000
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------
      # TCR gene-body profile split by mutation-rate group
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      mut_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$mut_Group)

      tcr_mut_df <- as.data.frame(tcr_mat) %>%
        mutate(mut_group = mut_groups) %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = -c(mut_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
        mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(tcr_mat))))

      TCR_MutDensities <- tcr_mut_df %>%
        group_by(mut_group, position) %>%
        summarise(
          mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]][[paste0(tcr_id, "_MutGroup")]] <- TCR_MutDensities

      TCR_MutGroupPlot <-
        ggplot(
          TCR_MutDensities,
          aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = mut_group, fill = mut_group)
        ) +
        geom_line(size = .5) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
                    alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(start_tcr, end_tcr), linetype = "dotted") +
        labs(
          title = paste("TCR Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
          subtitle = "Grouped by mutation rate group",
          x = "Windows",
          y = "Mean log2(template / non-template)",
          color = "Mutation Rate Quantile",
          fill = "Mutation Rate Quantile"
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        theme(
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2)
      ) +
      guides(
          fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
          colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = TCR_MutGroupPlot,
        filename = paste0(
          R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
          "Epigenetic_TCR_Plots/",
          species_prefix,
          "/TCR_", tcr_id, "_MutGroup_", element_name, ".png"
        ),
        bg = "transparent",
        type = "cairo",
        units = "cm",
        height = 6,
        width = 8,
        create.dir = TRUE,
        dpi = 2000
      )

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------
      # TCR scatter plot and boxplot using one value per gene
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------
      tcr_plot_df <- plot_vcf_df %>%
        mutate(
          Overall_TCR_Group = cut_number(
            .data[[tcr_gene_col]] + runif(n(), -1e-6, 1e-6),
            n = 5,
            labels = as.character(1:5),
            ordered_result = TRUE
          )
        )

      tcr_spearman_test <-
        cor.test(
          tcr_plot_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
          tcr_plot_df[[tcr_gene_col]],
          method = "spearman"
        )

      tcr_pearson_test <-
        cor.test(
          tcr_plot_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
          tcr_plot_df[[tcr_gene_col]],
          method = "pearson"
        )

      Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[tcr_gene_col]] <- tcr_spearman_test
      Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[tcr_gene_col]]  <- tcr_pearson_test

      tcr_p1 <-
        ggplot(
          data = tcr_plot_df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[tcr_gene_col]])),
          aes(
            x = !!sym(tcr_gene_col),
            y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
          )
        ) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
        labs(
          title = paste(
            tcr_gene_col, "\n",
            tcr_plot_df$GENE_ID %>% unique() %>% length(),
            "Unique Protein Coding Genes with TCR Estimate"
          ),
          subtitle = paste0(
            "Spearman Correlation: ",
            "p Value = ", signif(tcr_spearman_test$p.value, 5),
            ", Coefficient = ", signif(tcr_spearman_test$estimate, 5),
            "\nPearson Correlation: ",
            "p Value = ", signif(tcr_pearson_test$p.value, 5),
            ", Coefficient = ", signif(tcr_pearson_test$estimate, 5)
          ),
          caption = "Line of best fit represents linear regression line produced using: geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE)"
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = tcr_p1,
        filename = paste0(
          R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
          "Epigenetic_TCR_Scatter_Plots/",
          species_prefix, "/",
          species_prefix, "_", tcr_id, "_TCR_versus_MutationRate_", element_name, ".png"
        ),
        create.dir = TRUE,
        width = 5,
        height = 4,
        dpi = 300
      )

      tcr_box_df <- tcr_plot_df %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[tcr_gene_col]]), !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)) %>%
        mutate(
          Overall_TCR_Group = cut_number(
            .data[[tcr_gene_col]] + runif(n(), -1e-6, 1e-6),
            n = 5,
            labels = as.character(1:5),
            ordered_result = TRUE
          )
        )

      tcr_p2 <-
        ggplot(
          tcr_box_df,
          aes(
            x = Overall_TCR_Group,
            y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
            fill = Overall_TCR_Group
          )
        ) +
        geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(
            species_prefix, "\n",
            tcr_box_df %>%
              pull(GENE_ID) %>%
              unique() %>%
              length(),
            " Protein Coding Genes\nwith XR TCR"
          ),
          subtitle = paste0(
            "Jonckheere = ",
            jonckheere.test(
              tcr_box_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
              tcr_box_df$Overall_TCR_Group,
              alternative = "two.sided"
            )$statistic %>% round(3),
            ", p = ",
            jonckheere.test(
              tcr_box_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
              tcr_box_df$Overall_TCR_Group,
              alternative = "two.sided"
            )$p.value %>% round(3)
          ),
          x = "TCR Quantile",
          y = "Mutation Rate"
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = colorRampPalette(
            c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
          )(length(unique(tcr_box_df$Overall_TCR_Group)))
        ) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
        )

      ggsave(
        plot = tcr_p2,
        filename = paste0(
          R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
          "Epigenetic_TCR_JK_Plots/",
          species_prefix, "/",
          species_prefix, "_", tcr_id, "_TCR_Bins_versus_MutationRate_", element_name, ".png"
        ),
        bg = "transparent",
        create.dir = TRUE,
        width = 2,
        height = 3,
        dpi = 300
      )
    }
  }

  # Add GC_percentage column if doesn't exist
  vcf_df <- vcf_df %>%
    mutate(
      GC_Percentage = as.numeric(GC_Length) / as.numeric(cDNA_length)
    )

  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]] <- vcf_df

  expression_spearman_test <-
    cor.test(
      plot_vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      plot_vcf_df$log2_Expression_Plus_One,
      method = "spearman"
    )

  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][["log2_Expression_Plus_One"]] <- expression_spearman_test

  GC_spearman_test <-
    cor.test(
      vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      log(vcf_df$GC_Percentage),
      method = "spearman"
    )

  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][["GC_Percentage"]] <- GC_spearman_test

  width_spearman_test <-
    cor.test(
      plot_vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      log(plot_vcf_df$cDNA_length),
      method = "spearman"
    )

  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][["cDNA_length"]] <- width_spearman_test

  message("Processed: ", element_name, " (species: ", species_name, ")")
}
```

```{r LASSO Hybrid Version}

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {
  
  # 1️⃣ Get the VCF-like data for this species
  element <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]]
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(substr(species_name, 1, 1), "_", substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name)))
  
  # Subset to Only Covariate and Predictor Columns
  element_data <- element %>%
  dplyr::select(GENE_ID, 
         UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, 
         log2_Expression_Plus_One, 
         GC_Percentage,
         matches(c("H3K27me3$","H3K36me3$",
                 "HP1$","HPL2",
                 "H3K9me2$","H3K9me3$",
                 "H3K9ac$","H4K5ac$",
                 "H3K4me1$","H3K4me3",
                 #"cDNA_length",
                 #"plus$",
                 #"minus$",
                 "mean_replication")))
  
  # Working with complete cases for now
  element_data_complete_cases <-
  element_data[complete.cases(element_data) == TRUE,] %>% unique()

  # 1️⃣ Split into training and testing sets
  set.seed(69)
  index <- createDataPartition(element_data_complete_cases$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_df <- element_data_complete_cases[index, ]
  test_df  <- element_data_complete_cases[-index, ]

  # 2️⃣ Prepare matrices
  y_train <- train_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
  X_train <- scale(train_df[, setdiff(names(train_df), c("GENE_ID","UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"))])  # standardize
  y_test  <- test_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
  X_test  <- scale(test_df[, setdiff(names(test_df), c("GENE_ID","UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"))], 
                 center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"), 
                 scale  = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale"))  # use same scaling!

  # 3️⃣ Cross-validated LASSO on training set
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)

  # 4️⃣ Evaluate on test set
  pred_test <- predict(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min", newx = X_test)
  test_R2 <- cor(pred_test, y_test)^2
  test_RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y_test - pred_test)^2))

  test_R2
  test_RMSE

  # 5️⃣ Extract coefficients for interpretation
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")))
  coef_df$variable <- rownames(coef_df)
  colnames(coef_df)[1] <- "coefficient"
  coef_df <- subset(coef_df,
                    variable != "(Intercept)")
  coef_df$p_value <- ""
  coef_df$test <- "LASSO"

  # Plot LASSO Coefficients
  LASSO_Coefficients_Plot <-
  ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#1b9e77", "FALSE" = "#d95f02"),
    labels = c("Negative", "Positive")) +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO Variable Importance for Mutation Rate",
    subtitle = paste0("Cross-validated LASSO (λ = ", round(test_R2, 5), ")"),
    x = "Predictor variable",
    y = "Standardized coefficient",
    fill = "Effect direction") +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "top")

  # Collapse Simple Correlation Results into Dataframe
  species_dfs <- lapply(Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests, function(species_list) {
  data.frame(
    variable = names(species_list),
    coefficient = sapply(species_list, function(x) x$estimate),  # Spearman correlation coefficient
    p_value = sapply(species_list, function(x) x$p.value),
    test = "Spearman",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
    
    # Combine Simple Correlation and LASSO Results
    combined_results <- 
      rbind(
      species_dfs[[species_prefix]],
      coef_df)
    # Set Test type as Factor to set ordering in plot
    combined_results$test <- factor(combined_results$test,
                                    levels = c("Spearman","LASSO"))
    
    # Rename cDNA_length to gene_width
    combined_results$variable <- gsub("cDNA_length","gene_width", combined_results$variable)
  
     
    # Plot Facetable Bar Plot
  LASSO_Spearman_Coefficients_Plot <-
  ggplot() +
  # The Spearman Plot
  geom_col(data = subset(combined_results,
                         test == "Spearman" &
                         variable %in% c(coef_df$variable)),
  aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient),
  colour = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#003300", mid = "white", high = "orange", midpoint = 0) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
  # Reset Scales
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # The LASSO Plot
  geom_col(data = subset(combined_results,
                         test == "LASSO" &
                         variable %in% c(coef_df$variable)),
  aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient),
  colour = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#003300", mid = "white", high = "orange", midpoint = 0) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
  # Theming
  facet_grid(~test, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = paste(species_prefix, "\n", "LASSO Variable Importance for Mutation Rate"),
    subtitle = paste0("Cross-validated LASSO (λ = ", round(test_R2, 5), ")"),
    x = "Predictor variable",
    y = "Standardized coefficient"
  ) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 16) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE-4, angle = 90))

  # Save the plot — change width/height as needed
    ggsave(plot = LASSO_Spearman_Coefficients_Plot,
       filename = paste0(R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/", 
                               "Expression_Methylation_LASSO_Plots/",
                               element_name, "_",
                               "_LASSO_Model_Plot",".png"),
      bg = "transparent",
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 12.0,
      height = 3.4,
      dpi = 1000)
  
}
```

```{r Calculating TCR from XR Sequencing, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates_TCR <- Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates
processed_species <- character()

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]

  if (species_name %in% processed_species) next
  processed_species <- c(processed_species, species_name)

  vcf_df <- subset(
    Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]],
    gene_biotype == "protein_coding"
  )

  epigenetic_list <- Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates_TCR[[species_name]]
  if (is.null(epigenetic_list)) next

  gene_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = vcf_df$CHROM,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = vcf_df$start, end = vcf_df$end),
    strand   = vcf_df$strand,
    gene_id  = vcf_df$GENE_ID,
    gene_name = vcf_df$gene_name,
    dNdS_Group = vcf_df$Overall_dNdS_Group,
    mut_Group  = vcf_df$Overall_Expression_Group
  ) %>% unique()

  xr_names <- names(epigenetic_list)[grepl("XR", names(epigenetic_list), ignore.case = TRUE)]

  xr_bases <- unique(sub("(plus|minus|neg)$", "", xr_names, ignore.case = TRUE))

  for (base in xr_bases) {

    plus_name <- grep(
      paste0("^", base, "plus$"),
      xr_names,
      value = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    minus_name <- grep(
      paste0("^", base, "minus$|^", base, "neg$"),
      xr_names,
      value = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    if (length(plus_name) != 1 || length(minus_name) != 1) next

    plus_df  <- epigenetic_list[[plus_name]]
    minus_df <- epigenetic_list[[minus_name]]

    if (is.null(plus_df) || is.null(minus_df)) next

    plus_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = plus_df$chrom,
      ranges   = IRanges(start = plus_df$start, end = plus_df$end),
      value    = plus_df$value
    )
    strand(plus_gr) <- "+"

    minus_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = minus_df$chrom,
      ranges   = IRanges(start = minus_df$start, end = minus_df$end),
      value    = minus_df$value
    )
    strand(minus_gr) <- "-"

    plus_merged <- as.data.frame(mergeByOverlaps(gene_gr, plus_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE))
    minus_merged <- as.data.frame(mergeByOverlaps(gene_gr, minus_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE))

    if (nrow(plus_merged) == 0 || nrow(minus_merged) == 0) next

    plus_mean_df <- plus_merged %>%
      group_by(gene_id, gene_name, gene_gr.seqnames, gene_gr.start, gene_gr.end, gene_gr.strand) %>%
      summarise(plus_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    minus_mean_df <- minus_merged %>%
      group_by(gene_id, gene_name, gene_gr.seqnames, gene_gr.start, gene_gr.end, gene_gr.strand) %>%
      summarise(minus_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    tcr_df <- full_join(
      plus_mean_df,
      minus_mean_df,
      by = c("gene_id", "gene_name", "gene_gr.seqnames", "gene_gr.start", "gene_gr.end", "gene_gr.strand")
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        template_mean    = ifelse(gene_gr.strand == "+", minus_mean, plus_mean),
        nontemplate_mean = ifelse(gene_gr.strand == "+", plus_mean, minus_mean),
        value = log2((template_mean + 1) / (nontemplate_mean + 1)),
        CHROM = as.character(gene_gr.seqnames),
        start = gene_gr.start,
        end   = gene_gr.end,
        strand = as.character(gene_gr.strand)
      ) %>%
      select(
        CHROM, start, end, gene_id, gene_name, strand,
        value, template_mean, nontemplate_mean, plus_mean, minus_mean
      )

    colnames(tcr_df)[1] <- "chrom"
    epigenetic_list[[paste0(base, "_TCR")]] <- tcr_df[, c("chrom","start","end","value")]
  }

  Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates_TCR[[species_name]] <- epigenetic_list #["C_elegans_XR_TCR"]
}
```

```{r Calculate Mean Epigenetic Values for Each Gene and Run Correlations, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# Empty List for Correlation Results
Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests <- list()
Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests  <- list()

# Store XR window profiles here
Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities <- list()

# Store TCR window profiles here
Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities <- list()

pc <- 1e-6

for (element_name in names(Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants)) {

  # 1️⃣ Get the VCF-like data for this species and subset for protein coding genes
  vcf_df <- subset(
    Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]],
    gene_biotype == "protein_coding"
  )

  # 2️⃣ Extract species name
  species_name <- strsplit(element_name, "_")[[1]][4]
  species_prefix <- paste0(
    substr(species_name, 1, 1),
    "_",
    substr(species_name, 2, nchar(species_name))
  )

  # 3️⃣ Get corresponding epigenetic data
  epigenetic_list <- Species_Epigenetics_and_Covariates[[species_name]]

  # 4️⃣ Convert gene coordinates to GRanges
  gene_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = vcf_df$CHROM,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = vcf_df$start, end = vcf_df$end),
  strand   = vcf_df$strand,
  gene_id  = vcf_df$GENE_ID,
  gene_name = vcf_df$gene_name,
  dNdS_Group = vcf_df$Overall_dNdS_Group,
  expr_Group = vcf_df$Overall_Expression_Group,
  mut_Group  = vcf_df$Overall_Mutation_Rate_Group
) %>% unique()
  )

  # 5️⃣ Loop through each epigenetic dataset for this species
  for (mark_name in names(epigenetic_list)) {

    mark_name_nospecies <- str_split(mark_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[3]
    mark_df <- epigenetic_list[[mark_name]]

    # Skip if the element is NULL
    if (is.null(mark_df)) next

    # Convert to GRanges object
    mark_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = mark_df$chrom,
      ranges   = IRanges(start = mark_df$start, end = mark_df$end),
      value    = mark_df$value
    )

    # Add strand information if needed
    if (mark_name %like% "plus") {
      strand(mark_gr) <- "+"
    }
    if (mark_name %like% "neg" | mark_name %like% "minus") {
      strand(mark_gr) <- "-"
    }

    # 5️⃣ Metagene EnrichedHeatmap of Epigenetic Mark Around Gene Body
    body_epi_enrichment <- normalizeToMatrix(
      mark_gr,
      gene_gr,
      value_column = "value",
      extend = 1000,
      mean_mode = "weighted",
      w = 50,
      target_ratio = .7,
      smooth = FALSE,
      background = 0
    )

    # Extract Enrichment Bins and Grouping Indexing Information
    mat <- as.matrix(body_epi_enrichment)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gene-body profile split by expression group
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    expr_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$expr_Group)

    expr_df <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(expr_group = expr_groups) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -c(expr_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(mat))))

    ExprDensities <- expr_df %>%
      group_by(expr_group, position) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    if (is.null(Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]])) {
      Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]] <- list()
    }
    Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]][[paste0(mark_name, "_ExprGroup")]] <- ExprDensities

    # Keep your original boundary logic exactly
    avg <- colMeans(mat)
    regionLength <- ((0.7 * 100) * length(avg)) / 100
    lengthEachSide <- (length(avg) - regionLength) / 2
    start <- lengthEachSide
    end <- length(avg) - lengthEachSide

    # Plot grouped by expression group
    ExprDensityPlot <-
      ggplot(
        ExprDensities %>% subset(., is.na(expr_group) == FALSE),
        aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = expr_group, fill = expr_group)
      ) +
      geom_line(size = .5) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
                  alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(start, end), linetype = "dotted") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Enrichment of", mark_name_nospecies, "Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
        subtitle = "Grouped by expression group",
        x = "Windows",
        y = paste("Mean", mark_name_nospecies),
        color = "Expression Group",
        fill = "Expression Group"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
  )

    ggsave(
      plot = ExprDensityPlot,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_EnrichedHeatmaps/",
        species_prefix,
        "/GeneBody_Enrichment_of_", mark_name_nospecies, "_ExprGroup_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      bg = "transparent",
      type = "cairo",
      units = "cm",
      height = 6,
      width = 8,
      create.dir = TRUE,
      dpi = 2000
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gene-body profile split by mutation-rate group
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    mut_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$mut_Group)

    mut_df <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(mut_group = mut_groups) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -c(mut_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(mat))))

    MutationDensities <- mut_df %>%
      group_by(mut_group, position) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    # Store XR plus/minus window summaries
    if (grepl("XRplus|XRminus|XRneg", mark_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      Species_XR_Window_MutationDensities[[species_name]][[paste0(mark_name, "_MutGroup")]] <- MutationDensities
    }

    # Plot grouped by mutation rate quantile
    MutationDensityPlot <-
      ggplot(
        MutationDensities,
        aes(x = position, y = mean_score, color = mut_group, fill = mut_group)
      ) +
      geom_line(size = .5) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se, ymax = mean_score + se),
                  alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(start, end), linetype = "dotted") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Enrichment of", mark_name_nospecies, "Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
        subtitle = "Grouped by mutation rate group",
        x = "Windows",
        y = paste("Mean", mark_name_nospecies),
        color = "Mutation Rate Quantile",
        fill = "Mutation Rate Quantile"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
  )
      

    ggsave(
      plot = MutationDensityPlot,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_EnrichedHeatmaps/",
        species_prefix,
        "/GeneBody_Enrichment_of_", mark_name_nospecies, "_MutGroup_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      bg = "transparent",
      type = "cairo",
      units = "cm",
      height = 6,
      width = 8,
      create.dir = TRUE,
      dpi = 2000
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # NEW: proper TCR gene-body profile
    # Only compute this for XRplus, using its matching XRminus track.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (grepl("XRplus$", mark_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {

      minus_name <- sub("XRplus$", "XRminus", mark_name, ignore.case = TRUE)

      if (minus_name %in% names(epigenetic_list)) {

        minus_df <- epigenetic_list[[minus_name]]

        if (!is.null(minus_df)) {

          minus_gr <- GRanges(
            seqnames = minus_df$chrom,
            ranges   = IRanges(start = minus_df$start, end = minus_df$end),
            value    = minus_df$value
          )
          strand(minus_gr) <- "-"

          # Use the already-computed plus-track matrix as plus_mat
          plus_mat <- mat

          # Compute the minus-track matrix on the same gene set
          minus_mat <- as.matrix(normalizeToMatrix(
            minus_gr,
            gene_gr,
            value_column = "value",
            extend = 1000,
            mean_mode = "weighted",
            w = 50,
            target_ratio = .7,
            smooth = FALSE,
            background = 0
          ))

          gene_strand <- as.character(strand(gene_gr))
          plus_idx  <- which(gene_strand == "+")
          minus_idx <- which(gene_strand == "-")

          # Template/non-template matrices oriented by gene strand
          template_mat <- rbind(
            minus_mat[plus_idx, , drop = FALSE],
            plus_mat[minus_idx, , drop = FALSE]
          )

          nontemplate_mat <- rbind(
            plus_mat[plus_idx, , drop = FALSE],
            minus_mat[minus_idx, , drop = FALSE]
          )

          avg_tcr <- colMeans(template_mat)
          regionLength_tcr <- ((0.7 * 100) * length(avg_tcr)) / 100
          lengthEachSide_tcr <- (length(avg_tcr) - regionLength_tcr) / 2
          start_tcr <- lengthEachSide_tcr
          end_tcr <- length(avg_tcr) - lengthEachSide_tcr

          # ==============================================================
          # TCR profile split by expression group
          # ==============================================================
          gene_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$expr_Group)

          template_groups <- c(gene_groups[plus_idx], gene_groups[minus_idx])
          nontemplate_groups <- template_groups

          template_df <- as.data.frame(template_mat) %>%
            mutate(expr_group = template_groups) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = -c(expr_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
            mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(template_mat)))) %>%
            group_by(expr_group, position) %>%
            summarise(
              mean_score_template = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              se_template = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop"
            )

          nontemplate_df <- as.data.frame(nontemplate_mat) %>%
            mutate(expr_group = nontemplate_groups) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = -c(expr_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
            mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(nontemplate_mat)))) %>%
            group_by(expr_group, position) %>%
            summarise(
              mean_score_nontemplate = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              se_nontemplate = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop"
            )

          tcr_expr_df <- full_join(
            template_df,
            nontemplate_df,
            by = c("expr_group", "position")
          ) %>%
            mutate(
              strand_bias = log2((mean_score_template + pc) / (mean_score_nontemplate + pc)),
              bias_se = sqrt(
                (se_template / ((mean_score_template + pc) * log(2)))^2 +
                  (se_nontemplate / ((mean_score_nontemplate + pc) * log(2)))^2
              )
            ) %>%
            arrange(expr_group, position)

          if (is.null(Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]])) {
            Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]] <- list()
          }

          Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]][[paste0(sub("XRplus$", "XR_TCR_ExprGroup", mark_name, ignore.case = TRUE))]] <- tcr_expr_df

          TCR_ExprGroupPlot <-
            ggplot(
              tcr_expr_df %>% subset(., is.na(expr_group) == FALSE),
              aes(x = position, y = strand_bias, color = expr_group, fill = expr_group)
            ) +
            geom_line(size = .5) +
            geom_ribbon(
              aes(ymin = strand_bias - bias_se, ymax = strand_bias + bias_se),
              alpha = 0.2,
              color = NA
            ) +
            geom_vline(xintercept = c(start_tcr, end_tcr), linetype = "dotted") +
            theme_bw() +
            labs(
              title = paste("Enrichment of TCR Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
              subtitle = "Grouped by expression group",
              x = "Windows",
              y = "Mean log2(template / non-template)",
              color = "Expression Group",
              fill = "Expression Group"
            ) +
            scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE- 4),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
  )
          
          ggsave(
            plot = TCR_ExprGroupPlot,
            filename = paste0(
              R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
              "Epigenetic_TCR_Plots/",
              species_prefix,
              "/TCR_", mark_name_nospecies, "_ExprGroup_", element_name, ".png"
            ),
            bg = "transparent",
            type = "cairo",
            units = "cm",
            height = 6,
            width = 8,
            create.dir = TRUE,
            dpi = 2000
          )

          # ==============================================================
          # TCR profile split by mutation-rate group
          # ==============================================================
          gene_groups <- as.factor(gene_gr$mut_Group)

          template_groups <- c(gene_groups[plus_idx], gene_groups[minus_idx])
          nontemplate_groups <- template_groups

          template_df <- as.data.frame(template_mat) %>%
            mutate(mut_group = template_groups) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = -c(mut_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
            mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(template_mat)))) %>%
            group_by(mut_group, position) %>%
            summarise(
              mean_score_template = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              se_template = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop"
            )

          nontemplate_df <- as.data.frame(nontemplate_mat) %>%
            mutate(mut_group = nontemplate_groups) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = -c(mut_group), names_to = "position", values_to = "value") %>%
            mutate(position = as.numeric(factor(position, levels = colnames(nontemplate_mat)))) %>%
            group_by(mut_group, position) %>%
            summarise(
              mean_score_nontemplate = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              se_nontemplate = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop"
            )

          tcr_mut_df <- full_join(
            template_df,
            nontemplate_df,
            by = c("mut_group", "position")
          ) %>%
            mutate(
              strand_bias = log2((mean_score_template + pc) / (mean_score_nontemplate + pc)),
              bias_se = sqrt(
                (se_template / ((mean_score_template + pc) * log(2)))^2 +
                  (se_nontemplate / ((mean_score_nontemplate + pc) * log(2)))^2
              )
            ) %>%
            arrange(mut_group, position)

          Species_XR_TCR_Window_Densities[[species_name]][[paste0(sub("XRplus$", "XR_TCR_MutGroup", mark_name, ignore.case = TRUE))]] <- tcr_mut_df

          TCR_MutGroupPlot <-
            ggplot(
              tcr_mut_df,
              aes(x = position, y = strand_bias, color = mut_group, fill = mut_group)
            ) +
            geom_line(size = .5) +
            geom_ribbon(
              aes(ymin = strand_bias - bias_se, ymax = strand_bias + bias_se),
              alpha = 0.2,
              color = NA
            ) +
            geom_vline(xintercept = c(start_tcr, end_tcr), linetype = "dotted") +
            theme_bw() +
            labs(
              title = paste("Enrichment of TCR Across", species_name, "Gene Bodies"),
              subtitle = "Grouped by mutation rate group",
              x = "Windows",
              y = "Mean log2(template / non-template)",
              color = "Mutation Rate Quantile",
              fill = "Mutation Rate Quantile"
            ) +
            scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 4)
  )

          ggsave(
            plot = TCR_MutGroupPlot,
            filename = paste0(
              R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
              "Epigenetic_TCR_Plots/",
              species_prefix,
              "/TCR_", mark_name_nospecies, "_MutGroup_", element_name, ".png"
            ),
            bg = "transparent",
            type = "cairo",
            units = "cm",
            height = 5,
            width = 8,
            create.dir = TRUE,
            dpi = 2000
          )

          # TCR binned plot stays mutation-rate based
          tcr_bin_df <- tcr_mut_df %>%
            filter(!is.na(strand_bias), !is.na(mut_group))

          TCR_BinnedPlot <-
            ggplot(
              tcr_bin_df,
              aes(x = mut_group, y = strand_bias, fill = mut_group)
            ) +
            geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
            labs(
              title = paste0(
                species_prefix, "\n",
                tcr_bin_df %>%
                  pull(mut_group) %>%
                  unique() %>%
                  length(),
                " Mutation Rate Groups\nwith XR TCR"
              ),
              subtitle = "TCR is log2(template / non-template)",
              x = "Mutation \n Rate \n Quantile",
              y = "TCR strand bias"
            ) +
            scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
            scale_fill_manual(
              values = colorRampPalette(
                c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
              )(length(unique(tcr_bin_df$mut_group)))
            ) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE -5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE-4))

          ggsave(
            plot = TCR_BinnedPlot,
            filename = paste0(
              R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
              "Epigenetic_TCR_Plots/",
              species_prefix,
              "/TCR_", mark_name_nospecies, "_Binned_", element_name, ".png"
            ),
            bg = "transparent",
            create.dir = TRUE,
            width = 2,
            height = 3,
            dpi = 300
          )
        }
      }
    }

    # 6️⃣ Merge by overlaps
    merged <- as.data.frame(mergeByOverlaps(gene_gr, mark_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE))

    # Compute mean of all overlapping values per gene range
    mean_df <- merged %>%
      group_by(gene_gr.seqnames, gene_gr.start, gene_gr.end) %>%
      summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    # Rename mean_value to indicate mean epigenetic modification type
    mean_mark_name <- paste("mean", mark_name_nospecies, sep = "_")
    colnames(mean_df) <- c(
      "CHROM",
      "start",
      "end",
      mean_mark_name
    )

    # 7️⃣ Attach new mean column back to the original VCF dataframe
    vcf_df <- merge(
      vcf_df,
      mean_df,
      by = c("CHROM", "start", "end"),
      all.x = TRUE
    )

    # Bin Genes by their chromatin mark
    vcf_df <- vcf_df %>%
      mutate(
        Overall_Mark_Group = cut_number(
          .data[[mean_mark_name]] + runif(n(), -1e-6, 1e-6),
          n = 5,
          labels = as.character(1:5),
          ordered_result = TRUE
        )
      )

    # 8️⃣ Epigenetic Mark versus Mutation Rate
    spearman_test <-
      cor.test(
        vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
        vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]],
        method = "spearman"
      )

    pearson_test <-
      cor.test(
        vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
        vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]],
        method = "pearson"
      )

    # Save results into object
    if (is.null(Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]])) {
      Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]] <- list()
      Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]]  <- list()
    }

    Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]] <- spearman_test
    Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]  <- pearson_test

    # Create a Scatter Plot
    p1 <-
      ggplot(
        data = subset(vcf_df, !is.na(vcf_df[[mean_mark_name]])),
        aes(
          x = !!sym(mean_mark_name),
          y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP
        )
      ) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          mean_mark_name, "\n",
          vcf_df$GENE_ID %>%
            unique() %>%
            length(),
          "Unique Protein Coding Genes with Mark Estimate"
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Spearman Correlation: ",
          "p Value = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$p.value %>%
            signif(., digits = 5),
          ", ",
          "Coefficient = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$estimate %>%
            signif(., digits = 5),
          "\n",
          "Pearson Correlation: ",
          "p Value = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$p.value %>%
            signif(., digits = 5),
          ", ",
          "Coefficient = ",
          Species_Chromatin_Type_Pearson_Tests[[species_prefix]][[mean_mark_name]]$estimate %>%
            signif(., digits = 5)
        ),
        caption = "Line of best fit represents linear regression line produced using: geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE)"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE -5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE-4))

    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      plot = p1,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_MutationRate_Scatter_Plots/",
        species_prefix, "/",
        species_prefix, "_",
        mark_name_nospecies, "_versus_MutationRate", "_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 5,
      height = 4,
      dpi = 300
    )

    # filter properly first — cleaner than putting subset() inside ggplot()
    plot_df <- vcf_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[mean_mark_name]])) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[["UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"]]))

    p2 <-
      ggplot(
        plot_df,
        aes(
          x = Overall_Mark_Group,
          y = UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
          fill = Overall_Mark_Group
        )
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          species_prefix, "\n",
          plot_df %>%
            filter(!is.na(Overall_Mark_Group),
                   !is.na(UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP)) %>%
            pull(GENE_ID) %>%
            unique() %>%
            length(),
          " Protein Coding Genes\nwith Embryonic ", mark_name
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Jonckheere = ",
          jonckheere.test(
            plot_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
            plot_df$Overall_Mark_Group,
            alternative = "two.sided"
          )$statistic %>% round(3),
          ", p = ",
          jonckheere.test(
            plot_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
            plot_df$Overall_Mark_Group,
            alternative = "two.sided"
          )$p.value %>% round(3)
        )
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = colorRampPalette(
          c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
        )(length(unique(plot_df$Overall_Mark_Group)))
      ) +
      guides(fill = "none") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE -5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE-4))

    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      plot = p2,
      filename = paste0(
        R_Data, "Plots/5_Mutation_and_Methylation_Association_Plots/",
        "Epigenetic_MutationRate_JK_Plots/",
        species_prefix, "/",
        species_prefix, "_",
        mark_name_nospecies, "_Bins_versus_MutationRate", "_", element_name, ".png"
      ),
      bg = "transparent",
      create.dir = TRUE,
      width = 2,
      height = 3,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }

  # Add GC_percentage column if doesn't exist
  vcf_df <- vcf_df %>%
    mutate(
      GC_Percentage = as.numeric(GC_Length) / as.numeric(cDNA_length)
    )

  # Save updated dataframe back into list
  Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants[[element_name]] <- vcf_df

  # Manual correlations already in vcf_df; GC_Percentage, gene width and Expression
  expression_spearman_test <-
    cor.test(
      vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      vcf_df$log2_Expression_Plus_One,
      method = "spearman"
    )

  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][["log2_Expression_Plus_One"]] <- expression_spearman_test

  GC_spearman_test <-
    cor.test(
      vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      log(vcf_df$GC_Percentage),
      method = "spearman"
    )

  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][["GC_Percentage"]] <- GC_spearman_test

  width_spearman_test <-
    cor.test(
      vcf_df$UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP,
      log(vcf_df$cDNA_length),
      method = "spearman"
    )

  Species_Chromatin_Type_Spearman_Tests[[species_prefix]][["cDNA_length"]] <- width_spearman_test

  message("Processed: ", element_name, " (species: ", species_name, ")")
}
```
